observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor room with a patterned rug, curtains, and decorative statues, appearing to be an instructional dance video or home studio setting.
observation.formation_and_space: Solo dancer staying stationary in the center of the frame, stepping forward and backward on the spot.
observation.posture: Upright torso, relaxed knees with gentle bouncing or weight shifts, bare feet.
observation.footwork: Stepping forward and back with alternating legs while the supporting foot stays largely in place with the heel lifting up and down.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move in opposition to the legs, starting with one hand on hip and the other behind the head or moving in fluid figure-eight patterns.
observation.hips_and_torso: Hips push back slightly on the back step; torso remains upright while demonstrating hip pushes and figure-eights.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: No jumps, floor work, or turns; maintained at a standing level.
observation.costume_and_props: Black crop top, black leggings, and a decorative coin/beaded hip scarf with draped fabric.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact acoustic instrumentation and precise weight transfers due to compression and audio quality.

signature_moments.what: Basic step forward and back with alternating legs and heel lifts, one hand on hip and one behind the head.
Adding opposing arm movements that sweep back and forward as the legs step forward and back.
Double-time push action of the hips on the backward step with corresponding opposing arm shifts.
